_meta.folk: Proposed additions to text_bible_v0.json. Not canon. Read TEXT_BIBLE.md for the law before changing a string.
_meta._schema: {key: {folk, church, state, numb1?, numb2?, numb3?, proposed}}. Identical to text_bible_v0.json plus the `proposed` marker. null = this register has no word for this thing (deliberate absence). Omitted numb1/2/3 = this key does not degrade (spoken lines, register-locked scenes). "" at a numb step = the line is not shown at that step. {n}/{name} are runtime substitutions.
_meta._status: PROPOSED — every entry in this file is a proposal, not canon, and every entry carries "proposed": true. Adoption is the owner's call: a string may not enter text_bible_v0.json without a TEXT_BIBLE.md amendment (§0, §9). Canon wins on any key collision; game/src/app/hud/bible.ts layers this file UNDER the shipping artifact and bible.test.ts fails the build if a key here collides.
_meta._reason: Four gaps the slice cannot render without: (a) ui.menu.*/ui.settings.* — the §8-style dispute already flagged in game/src/app/menus/logic.ts, whose MENU_CHROME table exists only because the bible authors no chrome keys; strings here are that table verbatim, so adoption changes no pixel. (b) the cabin prologue's per-verb prompts (DrawWater, CarryWater, BreakBread, ShareBread, DoseAnna), which currently share the generic ui.prompt.interact. (c) the Warden aftermath WalkAway verb, which has an outcome line (boss.aftermath.walked_away) but no prompt of its own beside boss.aftermath.write_prompt. (d) the Birdie coda end card that closes the playable slice. Authoring follows §7: folk <=14 words, no quest-log or triumph register, State fileable and never sneering. Coda keys omit numb* because the Birdie coda is register-locked (L-T4).
